definitions.explanation: chemical formula; a symbolic representation of the composition of a chemical compound

notes:
A compound of ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧ (chemistry) and {式|しき} (formula/expression). One of the foundational terms in Japanese science education, introduced in middle school (⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧).
